verdict.rationale: Clerky documents a Partner API that lets a program create document sets, submit JSON values and poll for lifecycle state, so some workflow steps can be driven without the UI. However, its authentication is explicitly 'coming soon' and uses an interactive OAuth authorization-code flow, signing still happens on Clerky, and the live MCP server is a read-only assistant connector. Missing for 10: launched API access, non-interactive or service-token auth suitable for CI, a CLI or headless runner, end-to-end automation without in-app signing, and hands-on corroboration of CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Your product creates a document set, renders the forms the API returns, submits JSON values, and polls for lifecycle state.
Create a document set from a template. | [`POST /v1/document_sets`]
OAuth-based access is coming soon; client registration, URLs, scopes, token lifetime, and refresh behavior will be published before partner integrations launch.
